scenes.text: Identify, explain and apply the important ideas behind save and find work.
Save: stores changes to a document. Save As: can create a copy with a new name.
Backup: is an extra copy kept for safety. Restore: brings back a recoverable item. Delete: removes a selected item.
With an adult supervising, practise save and save as using a computer if one is available. Without a computer, draw the screen and explain each step to a partner.
